transcription: Ambuya vakafuga jira ravo, muhuro mavo vanenekiresi nemadhikausi munzeve, vakachembera.

transcription: Musikana arikunyemwerera akapfeka dhuku re bhuruu, ne rokwe reruvara rweshizha. Anenge akagara pamusoro pomugomo.  Zvinoratidzika  sokuti arikutorwa mufanikiso.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mvura zhinji iri mudziva inoratidza kuti yakachena uye inoratidza kuti haisi kunyatso kuyerera. Mujinga macho munoratidza kuti mune miti sezvo tichiona pane mashizha nezvimichero zvakadonhera mumvura umu.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Parengi pane vanhu vanotengesa zvakasiyana. Vamwe vakaronga pamatafura. Vamwewo vane zvingoro zvakamirira kutakura zvinhu zvevanhu. Pane bhazi rakamira rine ruvara rwe girini nerutsvuku uye zirori rakatakura zvinhu rine ruvara ruchena.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Gomo guru rakareba. Mujinga maro mune miti yakakura ine mashizha akawanda, uye pasi pakazara mauswa aneruvara rwegirinhi pamwechete nemusha uneruvara rwuchena.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo inoratidza kuti mudhorobha mune midhuri yakaenda mudenga kana kuti midhuri yemudurikidzanwa. Nechepazasi pane motokari iripo, motokari iyi ine ruvara ruchena neruvara rwakasvipira. Nechepamberi pake pane munhu ari kutengesa zvinwiwa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pedyo nemumugwagwa nechekurutivi kwawo kune imba yemudurikidzanwa. Kozotiwo mumugwagwa iwowo munemotokari nhema yakamira yakabatidza mwenje.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Bhazi hombe rine ruvara rweyero nerutsvuku kumashure. Rakamira parutivi pomugwagwa. Rine mafafitera akawanda akasvibira.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mutambo unotambirwa munhandare. Nhandare iyi ine huswa hwegirinhi. Mutambo urikutambwa icricket. Pane varume vaviri varikutamba. Mumwe akapfeka zveyero mumwe akapfeka sikipa yegirinhi

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mune imwe zvimbo inoita kunge  inotengeswa simbi . Pane murume akabata simbi , akapfeka chivhara muromo. Neche kure kwe murume uyu kune  vanhu vari kuzvifambira . Murume uyu aka pfeka zvekare  hembe nhema ,uyezve ane bhegi .

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Shiri mbiri dzakamhara padombo ,dzakanaka zvisingabviri. Dzinemapesu marefu egirinhi, dzoita pamusana pachena panezvepepuru ,dzakamharawo padombo rineruvara rwakatoredzana nadzo, uyewo kunemaruva egirinhi arikumberi. creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Imba hombe ine ruvara rwegireyi, ine mutsara mutsvuku pazasi, ine mikova miviri padivi nepamberi ine ruvara rwuchena, ine mafafitera zvekare padivi. Imba iyi iri pedyo nemiti muhombe nemidiki ine ruvara rwegirini.

transcription: Chigaro chakagadzirwa zvakanaka. Chine pokutsamhira, chine mitaro mitaro , chine makumbo akagadzirwa nematanda.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mureza unomiririra imwe nyika une ruvara rwedenga risina makore rwakasvibiruka neruvara ruchena pakati. Rwakanyorwa nezvitema zvine madodzi machena neruvara rwemashizha emiti kudivi rezasi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Vanhu vari munhandare varikukuza nhabvu. Vazhinji vavo vakamira vachiimba pamwechete nekukuza vatambi varimunhandare. Pane chinyorwa chinoratidza kuti vakamirira kuti mukombe uende kwavo.

transcription: Vhudzi rinoti apa rakagerwa apa rakatorukwa godha kubva pamusoro nekugotsi zvichidzika pamativi pomusoro pakagerwa nechigero chaitaratara.

transcription: Mwanasikana akamira akasimudza ruoko rwake rwerudyi. Akabata furegi yenyika yeZimbabwe ine ruvara rutema nezvitsvuku nezve yero nezvegirini. Musoro make mune vhudzi rakakura uye ndazi pahuma pake. Ari kusekerera.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo inoratidzawo kuti mugwagwa uri kudarika nepane biriji iro rakavakirirwa  masimbi rinoyerera mvura nechepasi paro. Mvura iyi inoitawo kuti mamwe mauswa akure chaizvo ayo ari kuoneka ari muzasi mebiriji.

creator: digital_umuganda

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Muti unoratidza kuti wanga waoma ukazoitawo tumabukira pasi. Tumabukira utwu twakazokura zvakanaka, zvakare twatovawo  namaruva machena. Pamaruva apa pazere tupukanana tunenge tuchida kuona chikafu pamaruva aya.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Madzimai vakasungwa mabhachi muchiuno pamwechete nemazambiya. Vanotengesa michero yema bhanana vakawadza pamasaga. uyewo vari kukanda marara pedo nepavari kushandira vasina kushambidza nzvimbo yavo.

transcription: Nzvimbo inotengeswa mitsvairo. Ine zvimurwi nezvimurwi zvemitsvairo nemadzimai akagara ari kutengesa mitsvairo iyi. Iri padhuze nechivakwa chakaita mudhadhadha chine ruvara rwegireyi chine zvirata pamusoro.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Bindu rine maruva akawanda. Maruva aya anotambarara uye mamwe acho ari kutotambarara achitevedzera fenzi achikwira kumusoro. Ane mashizha maduku uye mashizha aya ane ruvara rwegirinhi.

transcription: Churu chine ivhu dzvuku chakatuta chakazembera muti une hunde yakakora. Nechekumberi kuri kuoneka masaga emabhero edonje

transcription: Arikufamba ari pedyo ne chidziro chakawakwa chakawakwa nezvidhinha zvirefu zve samende uyewo pane miti imwe iri kubva mukati imwe irikunze irikuoneka iye akapakatira bhegi rake rinoberekwa kumusana akapfekawo nguwani uyewo akaisa chekuteereresa nziyo kubva munharembozha panzewe

transcription: Ruzhowa rwakashandisirwa chidhinha chikuru chinoratidza kushata chisina kunaka. Chidhinha ichi uye ruzhowa urwu haruna kunaka. creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Tswanda yakavhurika.  Mukati mayo mune michero inosanganisira chinanazi chimwe chete maranjisi manomwe.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Midziyo inonyanya kushandiswa kuchikoro yakafanana ne bhiro, guruu, nechekupinisa mabhuku. Midziyo iyi inonyanyo kushandiswa nevana varikutanga kudzidzira chikoro vekuma giredhi madoko kunyanya giredhi yekutanga.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mukadzi anemusoro unevhudzi pfupi wakagerwa kamutsara nechepadivi pemusoro kachibva pamhanza kachienda pakati pemusoro. Akapfeka rokwe rinemitsara webhuruu nemuchena neyero.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Madzimai mawiri anga achitamba mutambo wemakwikwi erunako. Vakapfeka hembe dzinosiya muviri wakashama. Madzimai maviri aya akasimudzwa maoko awo. Akasimudzwa nevarume vaviri. Zvichida madzimai aya ndoo akunda pamutambo werunako wacho.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mugomo makazara miti dzakawanda dzakareba uye dzinamashizha akasvibira egirini. Mujinga regomo mune zvivakwa zvine ruvara rwekirimu neruchena.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Besanwa mukufamba varume nevakadzi vamwe vakapfeka ngowani vamwe vakabereka mabheke pamativi vamwe kumusana.Madzimai vakarukwa zvechizvino-zvino vari kuratidza kuti vari kufamba.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Chivakwa chakakura uye chakaturikidzana.Chineruvara ruchena. Pasi pakazara sora rakanyasvibira rineruvara rwegirinhi uye rakanyatsochekererwa

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pane ndiro yemuti ine zvekudya. Zvekudya izvi zvakatsvukirira. Zvinosanganisira nyama inoita seyemombe, mbatata dzakachekwa uyezve pakaiswa muriwo pamusoro.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Miti yemuruva inonzi chikohwa. Yakasimwa kuseri  kwedzimba uye yakaiswa muma poto emaruva aneruvara rwepfumbu.  Chikohwa chinokwanisa kurapa zvirwere zvehuku uye kunyange zvirwere zvevanhu.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Imba huru yemudurukidzanwa yakapendwa nezvipfumbu uye mafafitera ari kupenya zvikuru ina maruva pasi payo nemusidari wakapfumburuka.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pedyo nemumwe mugwagwa,  pane chivakwa chemudurikidzwa. Chivakwa ichi pakaiswa chikwangwane pamberi. Kuzoti nechepasi pechovakwa ichi panevanhu varikufamba, uye dzimotokari dzinoita sedzakamira.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Ndiro ine ruvara rwesirivha,ine nyama yemaguru ine supu yematomatisi nemafuta akanuna.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Shumba mbiri hadzi yakamira nehono yakarara dzine ruvara rwebhurauni, pedyo nadzo nechemberi kune huswa hwave kuoma nechesure kune mvura ine huswa hushoma.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Muchero wen'i wakaibva ndokuomeswa, wakawanda une ruvara rweorenji, wakaiswa mumudziyo wetureyi uri patafura, pane tumashizha twemiti turi kubudira mukati metureyi iyi

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Vanhu vakamira pamadziro eyimba.Pane mukadzi akapakatira chibheke poita varume vaviri umwe akapfeka masiki pamuromo pake.Mumugwagwa mune motikari nemabhazi zviri kufambamo.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Munhukadzi mutsvuku ane musoro mumwe chete wakatorwa mufananidzo kubva kumativi akasiyana siyana anoti kumashure, kumberi naparutivi. Akarukwa zvakareba uye zvakarembera.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Chikafu chakabikwa zvinonwisa mvura, chiri mundiro uye chinosanganisira mupunga wakaiswa une muto uye nyama yakakangwa yakatsvukirira.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mamangositini akaunganidzwa anoratidza kuti arai kutengeswa.  Mamwe aneruvara rutsvuku, koitawo mamwe ane ruvara rutsvuku neruvara  rwakachenerukira.   Koitawo mamwe ane ruvara rwakada kusvibira  but ruri  rutsvuku.  Nechekumusoro mamwe ane mashizha egirinhi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mudzimai ari kufamba akananga kwaari kuenda. Akapfeka hembe yakanaka uyewo ane dhuku mumusoro. Maoko ake ese akabata chinhu. Nzvimbo yaari kufamba ine zvivako asi zvivako zvacho hazvina kunyatsonaka.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Motokari dzizhinji kwazvo dzimiri pedyo ne miti ine mashizha egirini ne chivakwa chine masimbi e sirivha ne zvidhinha zvakarongedzwa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Ishwa dzakabviswa mapapiro ndokuiswa mundiro. Dzakawanda uyewo dzine ruvara webhurauni. Dzine zvimusoro zviri kuoneka zvakakura uyewo  nezvimatumbu zvakareba. Ishwa dzikaiswa munyu dzinodiwa zvakanyanya nevanhu vanonwa doro.

creator: digital_umuganda

transcription: Nhandare inoratidza kuti ine shanje inombodiridzwa apo neapo sezvo  yakasvibira uye yakachekererwa zvakainzanirana. Mujinga menhandare iyi mune murume ari kufamba akapfeka mudhebhe mutema akarukwa mumusoro. Ruoko rwake rworudyi akabata mureza une mavara matsvuku nemachena.

transcription: Vanhu vakamira vamwewo varikufamba. Kune mukomana akabereka bhegi tema, uyewo pane bhazi rakamira nemotokari dzirikufamba.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mudhuri wakakomberedza imba. Wakavakwa nezvidhinha ukapurasitwa. transcription: Mugwagwa mukuru uri mudhorobha urikufamba motokari, nechekumberi kune motikari dzakamira, nevanhu vakamira vakazembera mapouro nemudzimai akatakura zikadhibhokisi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mugwagwa une motokari dzirikufambamo. Pane mukadzi akabereka bheke rake dema arikutarisa motokari kuti ayambuke mugwagwa. Mhiri kwemugwagwa kune zvitoro zviriko zvinosanganisira cheBakers Inn uye Service station.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzou ne mvuu zvirikufamba panzvimbo imwechete. Nzou idzi dzakakura uye dzine nzeve dzakakura zvakare. Nzvimbo yadziri inemakomo akawanda ázere miti nehuswa hwakawanda hune ruwara rwe girini.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Magaka akawanda anonzi magaka echirurungu makiyukamba. Anoratidza kugwinya uye kuti akasvika, akawana mvura nemanyowa zvakakwana. Magaka aya arikuratidza kuti achiri kunzwa, haasati asvava kuti atengeswe kana kuti adyiwe.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mureza unomiririra imwe nyika. Mureza uyu une mavara matatu, ruvara rwebhuruu, rutsvuku neruvara ruchena. Pamureza uyu pane ruvara rwebhuruu ruri pamusoro neruvara rwebhuruu ruri pakati neruri pokupedzisira. Pakati pemavara ebhuruu aya panopinda mavara machena. Nechekuruboshwe kune "triangle" yeruvara rutsvuku. Mukati me"triangle" iyi mune karuvara kachena.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nyemba tsvuku idzi dzakananikwa pazuva. Dzadururwa kubva mumugomo wesirivha. Mukati menyemba idzi mune dzimwe nhema.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pedyo nengoro inotengesa zvinwiwa. Pane murume akapfeka hembe chena nemudhebhe mutema neshangu nhema. ari kukanda nhanho. Murume uyu ari kukanda nhano akananga kune motokari dzinotakura vanhu dzakamira.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mune imwe nzvimbo inoita senhandare mune varume  vakawanda vakapfeka hembe dzakafanana . Vamwe vevarume ava vakapfeka hembe nhema,shangu nhema nemakepsei matema.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Baba vari kufamba papevhimendi padivi remugwagwa.  Mberi kwavo kune akagara ari kutengesa zvimwiwa zvakasiyana zvakagadzikwa pamusoro pengoro yebhuruu ine denderedzwa ritema rine njiva ichena mukati.   Pamusoro  pane bhaketi  richena rine muvharo webhuruu nemota  dziri kumashure.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Imba iri kuseri kwedombo hombe iri mukati mejuraworo. Kumberi kwayo kune zvidhina zvakapiswa zvekushandisa pakuvaka.

transcription: Zvinhu zvakasiyana zvinosanganisira zvekutambisa cricket, zvekutambisa tenesi bhora, magirovhosi, madart board nehembe dziya dzinopfekwa nevanenge vachitamba  mitambo dzatingati majezi dzakapfekedzwa pazvidhori. Zvinhu zvose zviri Apa zvitsva uye zvinoratidza kuti zvirikutengeswa.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Munhu agona zvemutambo arikupfekedzwa menduru.  Munhukadzi uye akakotamisa musoro . Arikupfekedzwa menduru ine ruvara rutsvuku.  Arikupfekedzwa nemunhu rume akapfeka heti chena mumusoro make.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Mota dzakamiswa pasi pemiti. Dzimwe dzichena uye dzimwe dzitema nesirivha. Murume akamira pedo nemuti. Miti ine mashizha. Mudenga mune makore machena. Pasi pakazara jecha uye huswa hwakaoma.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription:
Mugwagwa wemavhu urikusvika panzvimbo ine miti mizhinji mirefu yeruvara rwebumhudza uye nechepamberi pane motokari imwe chena imwe nhema dzakamiswa.
